email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG): war-focused clan with POAPs + Free Pass Royale (2000+ trophies)
email.body:
Hey — recruiting for POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG).

If you want a clan that actually tracks effort, celebrates milestones, and still plays to win, that’s us.

Quick snapshot (durable stats):
- Members: 37
- Required trophies: 2,000+
- Combined trophies: 233,576
- Weekly donations: 2,164
- Clan War trophies: 180
- Avg member level: 38.2

What makes POAP KINGS different:
- We’re war-minded, but low-drama. Real life comes first, but when you can play wars, we care about consistency.
- POAP culture is real here (Proof of Attendance / “Proof of Arena Push”). We like building a collectible record of seasons + clan moments.
- We run a Free Pass Royale reward for our War Champ each season (top war contributor). It’s meant to be earned, not handed out.
- We even have Elixir (our clan ops/record-keeper) helping us track wars, milestones, and shout-outs so effort doesn’t get forgotten.

Standouts you’ll see in-chat:
- raquaza (Co-Leader) — war driver; signature: The Log + Goblin Barrel; 12,277 trophies; 214 donations; 5,550 season fame.
- King Levy (Co-Leader) — steady war energy; signature: The Log + Giant Snowball; 11,532 trophies; 235 donations.
- King Thing (Leader) — builder/organizer; signature: Cannon + Witch; 10,328 trophies; 239 donations.
- Chanco (Elder) — donation engine; signature: Inferno Dragon + Witch; 250 donations.
- Vijay (Elder) — ladder power; signature: The Log + Goblin Barrel; 12,000 trophies; 4,950 season fame.

What we’re looking for:
- 2,000+ trophies
- Active players who donate and show up for Clan Wars when they can
- People who like a clan with structure, recognition, and momentum

If that sounds like your kind of home, take a look and hop in:
https://poapkings.com

— POAP KINGS recruiting
